## Summary
Greenfield build of **StockRoom**: a NestJS + Prisma/Postgres API with JWT auth and role-based access (clerk/manager), an Angular standalone-component SPA with fully URL-addressable routes, and a single multi-stage Docker image in which Nest serves the built Angular bundle.

## Scope

### Files to modify
- `README.md` — replace stub with run/dev/seed instructions and demo credentials.

### Files to create

**Repo root**
- `Dockerfile` — multi-stage: build `web/` → build `api/` → runtime stage copying `web/dist/web/browser` into `api/public`; entrypoint runs `prisma migrate deploy && node dist/main.js`.
- `docker-compose.yml` — `postgres:16` + `app`; wires `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `PORT`.
- `.dockerignore`, `.gitignore`, `.env.example`.

**Backend — `api/`**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `jest-e2e.json`
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — models below.
- `prisma/seed.ts` — idempotent (`upsert`): manager@demo + clerk@demo (`Demo1234!`, bcrypt), 8 items, 3 locations (`Zone A`, `Zone B`, `Zone C`), opening `StockLevel` rows.
- `src/main.ts` — global `ValidationPipe({whitelist, transform})`, `app.setGlobalPrefix('api', {exclude: []})` scoped so static assets are untouched, CORS for dev origin.
- `src/app.module.ts` — imports all modules; registers `JwtAuthGuard` and `RolesGuard` as `APP_GUARD`; `ServeStaticModule` (rootPath `public`, `exclude: ['/api/{*path}']`).
- `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`
- `src/common/decorators/public.decorator.ts`, `roles.decorator.ts`, `current-user.decorator.ts`
- `src/common/guards/jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`
- `src/auth/auth.module.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `dto/login.dto.ts`, `dto/signup.dto.ts`
- `src/users/users.service.ts`, `users.module.ts`
- `src/items/items.module.ts`, `items.service.ts`, `items.controller.ts`, `dto/create-item.dto.ts`, `dto/update-item.dto.ts`
- `src/locations/locations.module.ts`, `locations.service.ts`, `locations.controller.ts`, `dto/create-location.dto.ts`, `dto/update-location.dto.ts`
- `src/movements/movements.module.ts`, `movements.service.ts`, `movements.controller.ts`, `dto/create-movement.dto.ts`, `dto/query-movements.dto.ts`
- `src/reports/reports.module.ts`, `reports.service.ts`, `reports.controller.ts`
- `src/health/health.controller.ts`, `health.module.ts`
- `test/*.e2e-spec.ts` — auth, items, movements, reports.

**Frontend — `web/`**
- `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `src/index.html` (`<title>StockRoom</title>`), `src/styles.css` (design tokens), `src/main.ts`
- `src/app/app.config.ts` — `provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`
- `src/app/app.routes.ts` — route table (below), every entry carrying `data.flow`
- `src/app/core/auth.service.ts`, `core/auth.interceptor.ts`, `core/auth.guard.ts`, `core/role.guard.ts`, `core/api.ts` (typed HTTP wrappers), `core/models.ts`
- `src/app/shell/shell.component.ts` — brand "StockRoom", role-aware nav, logout
- Pages: `auth/login.page.ts`, `auth/signup.page.ts`, `items/item-list.page.ts`, `items/item-detail.page.ts`, `items/item-form.dialog.ts`, `locations/location-list.page.ts`, `locations/location-form.dialog.ts`, `movements/movement-new.page.ts` (wizard), `movements/movement-log.page.ts`, `reports/low-stock.page.ts`, `shared/forbidden.page.ts`
- `e2e/smoke.spec.ts` — Playwright: root renders `StockRoom`.

### Dependencies
- API: `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport,serve-static}`, `passport-jwt`, `@prisma/client`, `prisma`, `bcryptjs`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`; dev `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`.
- Web: `@angular/{core,common,forms,router,platform-browser}` v18+, `rxjs`, `zone.js`; dev `@angular/cli`, `@playwright/test`.
- Infra: Postgres 16 (compose service).

### Integrations
None — this build calls no third-party APIs, SDKs, or external services.

### Assumptions
- Monorepo layout `api/` + `web/`, one deployable image; Nest serves the SPA and `/api/*` on the same origin (no CORS in prod).
- Auth model = **full_auth** (no `## Auth` section in spec; actors are non-admin). Public routes: `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/signup`, `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`. Everything else guarded.
- Signup assigns `MANAGER` if the user table is empty, else `CLERK`. Seed runs first, so real signups become clerks.
- JWT in `Authorization: Bearer`, stored in `localStorage`, 12h expiry, payload `{sub, email, role}`.
- Duplicate SKU / duplicate location name → **400** with a validation-shaped body (spec says "validation error").
- Over-draw and malformed movements → **400**; role violation → **403**; missing/invalid token → **401**.
- Low-stock predicate: `SUM(StockLevel.qty) <= Item.reorderAt`.
- Movements are immutable — no update/delete endpoints.
- Angular Material is *not* used; hand-rolled CSS keeps the build lean and the smoke test's text assertion unambiguous.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Repo scaffold and deployment chain
**Files:** `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `.dockerignore`, `.env.example`, `api/package.json`, `web/package.json`
**Change:** Create the two workspaces and the multi-stage Dockerfile *first*, so every later step is built against the chain that actually ships. Stage 1 `npm ci && npm run build` in `web/`. Stage 2 `npm ci && npx prisma generate && npm run build` in `api/`. Stage 3 (`node:22-slim`) copies `api/dist`, `api/node_modules`, `api/prisma`, and `web/dist/web/browser` → `public/`. `CMD sh -c "npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/prisma/seed.js; node dist/main.js"` — seed is idempotent and non-fatal. Expose `PORT` (default 3000).

### Step 2: Prisma schema, migration, seed
**File:** `api/prisma/schema.prisma`
**Change:**
- `enum Role { CLERK MANAGER }`, `enum MovementType { IN OUT TRANSFER }`
- `User(id cuid, email @unique, passwordHash, role Role @default(CLERK), createdAt)`
- `Item(id, sku @unique, name, description String?, unit, reorderAt Int @default(0), createdAt, updatedAt)`
- `Location(id, name @unique, zone, createdAt)`
- `StockLevel(id, itemId, locationId, qty Int @default(0))` with `@@unique([itemId, locationId])` and an index on `itemId`
- `Movement(id, type, itemId, fromLocId String?, toLocId String?, qty Int, note String?, userId, createdAt)` with indexes on `(itemId, createdAt)` and `createdAt`; named relations `fromLoc`/`toLoc`.
Generate the initial migration. Write `seed.ts` with 8 items spanning stocked / low / zero states so the low-stock report has content on first load.

### Step 3: Nest core, health, global guards
**Files:** `src/main.ts`, `src/app.module.ts`, `src/prisma/*`, `src/health/*`, `src/common/*`
**Change:** `PrismaService extends PrismaClient` with `onModuleInit`. `JwtAuthGuard` extends `AuthGuard('jwt')` but returns `true` when `@Public()` metadata is present (reflector over handler + class). `RolesGuard` reads `@Roles(...)` and throws `ForbiddenException` on mismatch. Both registered as `APP_GUARD` in that order so auth-then-role is enforced everywhere by default. `GET /api/health` → `{status:'ok'}`; `GET /api/health/deep` → runs `SELECT 1` through Prisma, returns 503 on failure. Both `@Public()`.

### Step 4: Auth module
**Files:** `src/auth/*`, `src/users/*`
**Change:**
- `POST /api/auth/signup` `{email, password}` → bcrypt hash (cost 10); role = `MANAGER` iff `user.count() === 0` else `CLERK`; 400 on duplicate email; returns `{accessToken, user}`.
- `POST /api/auth/login` → validate with `bcrypt.compare`, 401 `Invalid credentials` on failure; returns `{accessToken, user}`.
- `GET /api/auth/me` → current user from JWT.
- `JwtStrategy` validates `sub` still exists and re-reads `role` from DB so role changes take effect on next request.
- Logout is client-side (token discard); no server endpoint.

### Step 5: Items module
**Files:** `src/items/*`
**Change:**
- `GET /api/items` (any authenticated) — supports `?q=` (sku/name contains, insensitive), `?lowStock=true`, `?page/?pageSize`. Returns each item with `totalQty` computed via `stockLevels` aggregate, plus `sku, name, unit, reorderAt` — satisfies the clerk-catalog scenario.
- `GET /api/items/:id` — includes `levels: [{locationId, locationName, zone, qty}]` and `totalQty`; 404 if absent.
- `POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/items` — `@Roles(Role.MANAGER)`.
- `CreateItemDto`: `sku` `@IsString @Matches(/^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$/)`, `name` required, `description` optional, `unit` required, `reorderAt` `@IsInt @Min(0)`.
- Create/update pre-check `findUnique({sku})` → `BadRequestException({message:['sku must be unique'], error:'Bad Request'})`; wrap in try/catch mapping Prisma `P2002` to the same 400 to close the race window. Guarantees "no second item is stored".
- `DELETE` refuses (400) when movements reference the item, preserving audit integrity.

### Step 6: Locations module
**Files:** `src/locations/*`
**Change:** Same shape as items. `GET /api/locations` open to any authenticated user (clerks must select locations when recording movements); `POST/PATCH/DELETE` manager-only. `CreateLocationDto`: `name`, `zone` required. Duplicate name → 400. `DELETE` refuses when any `StockLevel.qty > 0` or movements reference it.

### Step 7: Movements module — the transactional core
**Files:** `src/movements/*`
**Change:**
- `CreateMovementDto`: `type` `@IsEnum(MovementType)`, `itemId`, `qty` `@IsInt @Min(1)`, `fromLocId?`, `toLocId?`, `note?` `@MaxLength(500)`.
- Shape validation before the transaction: `IN` requires `toLocId` and rejects `fromLocId`; `OUT` requires `fromLocId` and rejects `toLocId`; `TRANSFER` requires both and rejects `fromLocId === toLocId`. Violations → 400.
- `POST /api/movements` (any authenticated — clerks record stock) executes one `prisma.$transaction(async tx => {...})`:
  - **Credit** (`IN`, `TRANSFER.to`): `tx.stockLevel.upsert({ where: {itemId_locationId}, create: {qty}, update: {qty: {increment: qty}} })`.
  - **Debit** (`OUT`, `TRANSFER.from`): `tx.$executeRaw\`UPDATE "StockLevel" SET qty = qty - ${qty} WHERE "itemId"=${itemId} AND "locationId"=${locId} AND qty >= ${qty}\`` — if the affected row count is `0`, throw `BadRequestException('Insufficient stock')`, rolling the whole transaction back. This is the *only* balance check; it is race-safe and guarantees the "stored balance remains 5" scenario without a read-then-write window.
  - Debit before credit on `TRANSFER`, so a failed debit never creates phantom stock and total quantity is conserved.
  - Finally `tx.movement.create({ ...dto, userId })`, so the audit row and the balances commit together.
- `GET /api/movements` — `@Roles(Role.MANAGER)`. Filters `?itemId=`, `?type=`, `?from=`/`?to=` (ISO dates, `to` inclusive to end-of-day), `?page/?pageSize`, ordered `createdAt desc`. Each row includes `user.email`, `item.sku/name`, `type`, `qty`, `fromLoc.name`, `toLoc.name`, `note`, `createdAt`.
- `GET /api/items/:id/movements` — item-scoped history, available to clerks on the item detail page.

### Step 8: Low-stock report
**File:** `src/reports/reports.service.ts`
**Change:** `GET /api/reports/low-stock` — `@Roles(Role.MANAGER)`. Single query:
`SELECT i.*, COALESCE(SUM(s.qty),0) AS "totalQty" FROM "Item" i LEFT JOIN "StockLevel" s ON s."itemId"=i.id GROUP BY i.id HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.qty),0) <= i."reorderAt" ORDER BY (COALESCE(SUM(s.qty),0) - i."reorderAt") ASC`. Returns `{id, sku, name, unit, reorderAt, totalQty, deficit}`. The `LEFT JOIN` ensures items with no stock rows at all still surface.

### Step 9: Angular scaffold, auth plumbing, guards
**Files:** `web/src/app/core/*`, `app.config.ts`, `app.routes.ts`, `shell/shell.component.ts`
**Change:**
- `AuthService` — signals `token`, `user`, computed `isManager`/`isAuthenticated`; hydrates from `localStorage` on construction; `login()`, `signup()`, `logout()` (clears storage, navigates to `/login`).
- `authInterceptor` — attaches `Authorization` when a token exists; on `401` clears session and redirects to `/login?returnUrl=<url>`; on `403` redirects to `/403`.
- `authGuard: CanActivateFn` — redirects unauthenticated users to `/login?returnUrl=...` (satisfies "shown the sign-in view rather than application data").
- `managerGuard: CanActivateFn` — requires `role === 'MANAGER'`, else `/403`.
- `ShellComponent` renders the **StockRoom** brand in the header plus role-aware nav: Items / Record Movement for all; Locations / Low Stock / Audit Log added for managers.

### Step 10: Route table — every navigable state addressable
**File:** `web/src/app/app.routes.ts`
**Change:** Each route carries `data: { flow: '<name>' }`.
- `/login` (public, `flow: 'auth.login'`) — page renders the "StockRoom" wordmark and demo-credential hint. This is the root redirect target for anonymous visitors, so it carries the smoke marker.
- `/signup` (public, `flow: 'auth.signup'`)
- `/403` (public, `flow: 'forbidden'`)
- `''` → `ShellComponent`, `canActivate: [authGuard]`, children:
  - `''` → redirect `items`
  - `items` `flow: 'items.list'` — query params `q`, `lowStock`, `page`, `sort` bound via `withComponentInputBinding`; `?modal=create-item` opens the manager-only item dialog (restored on reload).
  - `items/:id` `flow: 'items.detail'` — children `levels` (default, `flow: 'items.detail.levels'`) and `movements` (`flow: 'items.detail.movements'`) so tabs are deep-linkable; `?modal=edit-item`.
  - `locations` `flow: 'locations.list'`, `canActivate: [managerGuard]`; `?modal=create-location` / `?modal=edit-location&id=`.
  - `movements/new` `flow: 'movements.new'` — wizard state in `?step=1|2|3` plus `?itemId=&type=` so a partially-filled entry is restorable.
  - `movements` `flow: 'movements.log'`, `canActivate: [managerGuard]` — filters in `?itemId=&type=&from=&to=&page=`.
  - `reports/low-stock` `flow: 'reports.lowStock'`, `canActivate: [managerGuard]`.
- `**` → redirect `''`.

### Step 11: Item catalog and detail pages
**Files:** `items/item-list.page.ts`, `items/item-detail.page.ts`, `items/item-form.dialog.ts`
**Change:** List is a table of `sku · name · unit · reorderAt · totalQty`, with a low-stock badge when `totalQty <= reorderAt`, a search box and a low-stock toggle that both write to query params (never local state). "New item" / row edit / delete render only when `isManager()`. Detail shows the item header, a per-location `location · zone · qty` breakdown with a visible **Total** row equal to `totalQty`, and the item's movement history tab. Both dialogs are driven by the `modal` query param and surface API 400 messages inline on the offending field (so a duplicate SKU shows on the `sku` control).

### Step 12: Movement entry wizard
**File:** `movements/movement-new.page.ts`
**Change:** Three steps driven by `?step=`: (1) pick item (searchable select); (2) pick type `IN | OUT | TRANSFER` — the location controls show/hide/require per type, with an available-quantity hint per source location read from the item's levels; (3) quantity + note + confirm summary. Client-side it blocks `qty > available` for `OUT`/`TRANSFER`, but the server remains the authority — an API 400 is rendered as a form-level error and the user stays on step 3. On success, navigate to `/items/:id/levels` with a success toast. Available to clerks and managers alike.

### Step 13: Audit log and low-stock pages
**Files:** `movements/movement-log.page.ts`, `reports/low-stock.page.ts`
**Change:** Log renders `when · who (email) · item · type · qty · from → to · note`, with item-select, type-select and from/to date inputs all bound to query params and a paginator. Low-stock renders `sku · name · onHand · reorderAt · deficit`, sorted by worst deficit, with an empty state ("Everything is above its reorder threshold") and a link into each item's detail.

### Step 14: Static serving and README
**Files:** `src/app.module.ts`, `README.md`
**Change:** Confirm `ServeStaticModule` excludes `/api/{*path}` (Express 5 / Nest 11 path syntax — a legacy `/api/*` pattern throws at boot) and that unknown non-API paths fall back to `index.html` so deep links like `/items/abc/movements` survive a hard refresh. README documents `docker compose up`, the two demo logins, and the migrate/seed commands.

## Testing Strategy
- **API e2e (`supertest`, Postgres test DB, reset per suite):**
  - Unauthenticated call to `/api/items` → 401; `/api/health` → 200 without a token.
  - Login as clerk and manager with `Demo1234!` → 200 + token; wrong password → 401.
  - Clerk `POST /api/items` → 403; clerk `POST /api/locations` → 403; manager → 201.
  - Duplicate SKU `SKU-001` → 400 **and** `items.count({sku})` still 1.
  - IN 50 into Zone A → level 50, one movement row with the acting user, qty, type and timestamp.
  - OUT 20 → level 30. TRANSFER 10 A→B → A 20, B 10, `totalQty` unchanged.
  - OUT 10 against a 5-unit level → 400 **and** the level re-reads as 5.
  - reorderAt 10 / 12 on hand → OUT 5 → item present in `/api/reports/low-stock`; a 40-on-hand item absent.
  - `/api/movements?itemId=` and `?from=&to=` return only matching rows; clerk hitting it → 403.
- **Frontend:** Playwright smoke asserting the app root renders `StockRoom` (the seeded oracle), plus a login → item list → record IN → verify balance flow, and a deep-link reload test on `/items/:id/movements` and `/movements/new?step=2`.
- **Manual:** `docker compose up` from a clean volume must reach a working login page with seeded data and no manual migration step.

## Risks
- **Nest 11 / Express 5 route syntax** — `ServeStaticModule` exclusions and wildcard routes use `{*path}`, not `*`. Getting this wrong fails at boot or swallows `/api` requests into `index.html`; verify with a `curl /api/health` against the built image, not just against `nest start`.
- **Seed-on-boot** — must be idempotent (`upsert` by email/sku/name) and must not crash the container on re-run; failures should log and continue so a restart never takes the app down.
- **Transfer atomicity** — debit must precede credit inside the transaction, and the debit must be the conditional raw `UPDATE`; using a Prisma `decrement` instead reintroduces the negative-balance race the spec explicitly forbids.
- **Angular build output path** — v17+ emits to `dist/<project>/browser`; copying `dist/<project>` wholesale into `public/` yields a 404 on `/`. Confirm the path in `angular.json` before writing the Dockerfile COPY.
- **Smoke marker placement** — the oracle loads the app root while unauthenticated, so "StockRoom" must be in the *login* view's rendered DOM, not only the authenticated shell or the `<title>`.
- **Role read on every request** — re-reading `role` in `JwtStrategy` costs a query per request; acceptable at this scale and it prevents stale-token privilege drift.
